programmes.funder: Ignite - National Technology Fund, Ministry of IT and Telecommunication
programmes.amount_note: Government-supported initiative connecting Pakistani startups to international markets and investors. Financial terms are set per cohort.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort-based; check ignite.org.pk for the live call.

eligibility.other_note: Pakistani technology startups seeking international market entry.

programmes.source_snippet: The BridgeStart Pakistan is a pioneering initiative supported by the Pakistani government.

programmes.funder: Ignite - National Technology Fund, Ministry of IT and Telecommunication
programmes.amount_note: Grant funding for final-year and postgraduate ICT research and prototype projects at Pakistani universities, awarded per project. Amounts are set per call.
programmes.deadline_note: NGIRI runs as an annual call aligned with the university academic year; check ignite.org.pk for the live window.

eligibility.other_note: Students and faculty at Pakistani universities registered with Ignite. Not restricted to incorporated startups.

programmes.funder: Ignite - National Technology Fund, Ministry of IT and Telecommunication
programmes.amount_note: Grants to innovative deep tech projects and startups, awarded against Ignite's published calls. Amounts are set per call.
programmes.deadline_note: Awarded through periodic calls; no live deadline was published on the Ignite homepage at verification time.

eligibility.other_note: Pakistani companies, universities and research groups working on deep technology projects.

programmes.source_snippet: to innovative, deep tech projects and startups

programmes.name_local: Durshal incubation network (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Information Technology Board)
programmes.name_en: Durshal incubation network (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Information Technology Board)
programmes.amount_note: Equity-free incubation across Durshal centres in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa with workspace, mentoring and, in some cohorts, seed grants and challenge prizes. Amounts are set per cohort.
programmes.deadline_note: Durshal runs periodic cohort calls announced by KPITB.

eligibility.other_note: Founders based in or willing to operate from Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

programmes.funder: Ignite - National Technology Fund, Ministry of IT and Telecommunication
programmes.amount_note: Free or heavily subsidised incubation at nine National Incubation Centers (Islamabad, Lahore, Karachi, Peshawar, Quetta, Hyderabad, Faisalabad, Sialkot, and NICAT for aerospace), including workspace, mentoring, legal and accounting support and investor access. Some cohorts include a stipend or grant from the operating partner.
programmes.deadline_note: Each NIC runs its own cohort intake, typically two cohorts a year. Apply directly to the nearest centre.

procedure_steps.detail: Choose a National Incubation Center and apply during its open cohort call.
Screening and pitch before the selection panel.
Join the cohort with workspace, mentoring and support services.
Demo day and investor connects at the end of the cohort.

eligibility.other_note: Pakistani founders with a technology venture; incorporation is generally not required at application. Terms, including any equity share, vary by centre and operating partner.

programmes.funder: Ignite - National Technology Fund, Ministry of IT and Telecommunication
programmes.amount_note: Government-backed, equity-free grant support designed to help Pakistani startups close or bridge funding rounds. Award ceilings are set per call by Ignite.
programmes.deadline_note: Launched with an initial allocation announced by the Ministry of IT and Telecommunication; applications are received through Ignite's calls. No live deadline was published at the time of verification.
programmes.reopen_note: Watch ignite.org.pk/pakistan-startup-fund for the next call announcement.

procedure_steps.detail: Register on the Ignite portal when a PSF call is announced.
Submit the application with the startup's traction, cap table and funding round details.
Evaluation by the Ignite review panel.
Equity-free grant disbursed against agreed milestones.

eligibility.other_note: Pakistan-registered technology startups. Confirm current call criteria on the Ignite portal - the PSF sub-page returned an access error at verification time.

programmes.name_local: Plan9 incubation programme (Punjab Information Technology Board)
programmes.name_en: Plan9 incubation programme (Punjab Information Technology Board)
programmes.funder: Punjab Information Technology Board (PITB), Government of Punjab
programmes.amount_note: Equity-free incubation for Pakistani tech startups with workspace, mentoring and, in several cohorts, a monthly stipend to founding team members. Stipend and cohort terms vary by edition.
programmes.deadline_note: Plan9 runs cohort-based intakes announced on the PITB portal; check for the live cohort call.

eligibility.other_note: Pakistani founders with a technology product; teams are typically expected to relocate to Lahore for the cohort.

programmes.name_local: Prime Minister's Youth Business and Agriculture Loan Scheme (PMYB&ALS)
programmes.name_en: Prime Minister's Youth Business and Agriculture Loan Scheme (PMYB&ALS)
programmes.funder: Prime Minister's Youth Programme, Government of Pakistan (delivered through commercial banks)
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised business loans in three tiers: Tier 1 up to PKR 0.5 million (interest-free), Tier 2 above PKR 0.5 million and up to PKR 1.5 million at 5%, and Tier 3 above PKR 1.5 million and up to PKR 7.5 million at 7%. Tier 1 loans are clean; higher tiers require security per bank policy.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are open on a rolling basis through the PM Youth Programme portal and participating banks. Verify current markup rates and tier ceilings, which have been revised over time.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply online on the PM Youth Programme portal and select a bank.
Bank contacts the applicant for documentation and appraisal.
Sanction and disbursement; repayment over up to 5-8 years depending on tier.

documents_required.doc: Proof of business premises or intent
Security documents for Tier 2 and Tier 3

eligibility.other_note: Pakistani nationals broadly aged 21-45 (relaxed to 18 for IT and e-commerce businesses) with entrepreneurial potential. Applicants must not be defaulters. The business must be in Pakistan.

programmes.funder: Ignite - National Technology Fund with LMKT / partner operators
programmes.amount_note: Equity-free cohort incubation with workspace, mentoring, legal and accounting support and investor access at NIC Karachi. Some cohorts carry a stipend from the operating partner.
programmes.deadline_note: Cohort intakes are announced on nickarachi.com, typically twice a year.

eligibility.other_note: Pakistani founders with a technology venture willing to operate from Karachi.

programmes.name_local: SMEDA business development and SME support services
programmes.name_en: SMEDA business development and SME support services
programmes.funder: Small and Medium Enterprises Development Authority (SMEDA), Ministry of Industries and Production
programmes.amount_note: No general cash grant. SMEDA provides pre-feasibility studies, business plan development, regulatory facilitation, technology upgrade advice and access-to-finance facilitation for Pakistani SMEs, plus periodic donor-funded matching-grant windows.

eligibility.other_note: Pakistani small and medium enterprises and prospective entrepreneurs.
